blocks.text: Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez delivered her signature showmanship at the 2026 Miss Grand International Preliminary Competition, showing spectators a playful and energetic “pasarela” (pageant walk) routine. The crucial competition was held at the MGI Hall at Bravo BKK in Bangkok, Thailand, on Wednesday evening, Oct. 7, where the 77 delegates in this year’s pageant competed in swimsuit and gown. The Palaweña stunner sizzled on stage with her spins, turns, hair flips, big hand gestures and powerful gait, something her fans have been clamoring from her ever since.
